Uses of Package
io.webagent4j.policy.network

Packages that use io.webagent4j.policy.network
Package
Description
io.webagent4j.action
Verified browser actions: one explicit, bounded command pipeline per interaction, with three terminal modes - real execution, dryRun(), and plan() - that all share the exact same target-resolution and precondition logic so they can never disagree.
io.webagent4j.browsercrawler
A deterministic, bounded-concurrency browser crawler: JavaScript-rendered link discovery through a real browser session, reusing webagent4j-browser-api for navigation and webagent4j-wait for stability rather than a second wait/timing implementation.
io.webagent4j.crawler
The deterministic, sequential HTTP crawler engine: a java.net.http.HttpClient fetcher, jsoup link extraction, a breadth-first frontier, URL normalization/deduplication/scope policy, and redirect/retry handling - no browser, no JavaScript execution.
io.webagent4j.policy.network
Network-destination governance: INetworkPolicy decides whether WebAgent4J may make a network request to a given destination, evaluated strictly before the request is sent.

    VerifiedNetworkAddresses
    The exact IP addresses a transport is authorized to connect to for one destination, in resolution order, alongside the logical hostname it must still present for the Host header, TLS SNI, and certificate hostname verification - the physical address is never a substitute for the logical hostname in any of those three places.
